verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs describe Agent Skills as an open standard for giving agents specialized capabilities. Skills are portable, version-controlled packages that can bundle scripts, templates and references, and Cursor auto-discovers them at startup. Users invoke them with `/`, can add their own alongside built-in managed skills, and can install them from a unified plugins/skills hub. Custom subagents with their own prompts, tools and models add domain-specific extension. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that custom skills work as documented.
